title: Spellbreaker
shortDescription: Magic itself is failing — save it.
description: Spells that once made everyday life possible are starting to fail. At a guild meeting in Borphee, the other guildmasters are suddenly turned into amphibians, and a figure in a dark cloak slips out of the hall. Follow the figure and work out how a set of strange cubes fits into the unraveling of magic. This is the final adventure in the Enchanter trilogy.
author: Infocom

reviews.author: mage_master
reviews.title: Brutally difficult, deeply rewarding
reviews.body: This is Infocom at its hardest. Every puzzle requires careful thought and creative spellcasting. Not for the faint of heart.

reviews.author: enchanter_trilogy
reviews.title: A satisfying finale
reviews.body: The Enchanter trilogy ends on a high note. The spell system is ingenious and the puzzles are well-crafted, if extremely tough.
